text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's summer, and it's Chan-me. At a 
training camp with delicious food. Yay.

The season for the summer training camp 
has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ... Yes, Trainer, I just had an idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
How about a 4-koma manga featuring Chan 
enjoying the quintessential sights of 
summer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan-me eating watermelon, Chan-me going 
to the summer festival, Chan-me going stag 
beetle hunting...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"The plan is to let them feel my 
loveliness up close... and so forth."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sounds good. Sounds very good. It 
looks like this summer will be a busy one.

Her spring slump nowhere to be seen, Aston 
Machan is completely back to full energy, 
which brings me a bit of relief.

Come autumn, it's the Sprinters Stakes. I 
want to train harder and harder over the 
summer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't fool around too much during the 
camp! Make sure to read your handbook 
thoroughly. If you've got it, dismissed!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I'll head back to my room 
for a bit—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san! Did you know about this? 
Aston Machan's livestream!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
On the bus, we were just talking about how 
cool and decisive you are, Hishiama-san~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's that?! Now you've got me 
curious!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's from quite a while back, right after 
the Oka Sho, when Machan switched routes 
from the Tiara to sprints!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh, was that kind of broadcast really on?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! Reporting to the Trainer after 
the fact! "I decide my own path!" That 
kind of stance! Doesn't that sound so 
big-sis-like~?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I'm not really one for springing 
major news on someone important after the 
fact, personally.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Especially since a Trainer is your 
partner, right? All the more reason you 
ought to tell them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, kind of makes you curious, huh? 
I'll check it out later too."
